name: Tabletop studio
artStyle: hand-drawn 2D storybook illustration of a miniature film studio world on a wooden desk
line: warm dark-plum ink outlines, slightly uneven, medium weight
texture: soft watercolor fills on cream paper with faint grain
lighting: soft late-afternoon window light from the left
depth: three paper layers: desk foreground, studio middle, window and wall far
camera: gentle drift and small pushes only, eye level on the miniature world, first-person views for the founder's hand
transitions: hard cuts on action; the brand card cuts in on a bell

characters.role: the overworked founder; mostly seen as an oversized hand and a tired, then smiling face
characters.scale: human, oversized next to the studio

characters.role: the tiny crew of three (director with a beret, camera operator, set builder)
